item_types_slug.name: item_types_slug
item_types_slug.value: slug GLOB '[a-z0-9]*' AND length(slug) BETWEEN 1 AND 20

items_time_fmt.name: items_time_fmt
items_time_fmt.value: time IS NULL OR time GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]'

items_end_date.name: items_end_date
items_end_date.value: end_date IS NULL OR (date IS NOT NULL AND end_date >= date)

places_rating.name: places_rating
places_rating.value: rating IS NULL OR rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5

wlogs_effort.name: wlogs_effort
wlogs_effort.value: effort IS NULL OR effort IN ('light','moderate','heavy')

wsplit_effort.name: wsplit_effort
wsplit_effort.value: current_effort IS NULL OR current_effort IN ('light','moderate','heavy')
